shots.action: Ayra freezes, staring down at the broken cup pieces on the floor while Miso sits on the counter looking innocent.
shots.performance: Ayra: wide eyes, hands on cheeks, then forced smile. Miso: calm, blinks slowly.

shots.action: Inaya enters and looks at Ayra sitting on the floor in front of the pieces.
shots.performance: Inaya raises one eyebrow; Ayra grins nervously.
